subject: Seat reallocation + backfill approval request — Platform Eng -> Customer Reliability
messages:
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.com>
Cc: Tessa Morgan <tessa@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 15 Mar 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Seat reallocation + backfill approval request — Platform Eng -> Customer Reliability

Team — quick context and ask. We have an urgent capacity need in Customer Reliability: two senior ICs on that team are leading an FY26 Q2 initiative (regional SLA coverage and incident runbooks) and one has unexpectedly resigned effective 3/31. Platform Engineering has a low-priority internal project (data-prefetch experiments) that we can pause and repurpose one of their open headcount seats (Sr SE II) to backfill Customer Reliability immediately.

Impact assessment (attached):
- Short term: move 1 Sr SE II from Platform Eng to Customer Reliability as a reallocation; we request a backfill exception for Platform Eng to refill the paused project headcount later in Q4 if capacity returns.
- Cost: neutral for Q2 headcount spend (swap existing open slot).
- Risk: losing the data-prefetch experiment momentum but keeps customer-facing SLAs covered.

Ask: approval on seat reallocation + HR exception to mark the Platform Eng vacancy as paused/backfill-later. If approved, please confirm so I can loop in People Ops (Tessa/Elena) to create the exception record and kickoff the transfer. Attached: seat_realloc_memo_v1.pdf and headcount-impact-model.xlsx.

Thanks,
Vivek
Vivek Kulkarni
Director, Customer Reliability
Redwood Inference

------------------------------------------------------------------
From: Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.com>
Cc: Tessa Morgan <tessa@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 15 Mar 2026 09:39:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Seat reallocation + backfill approval request — Platform Eng -> Customer Reliability

Vivek — I support this in principle. Customer-facing SLOs > internal experiment right now. A couple quick asks before I sign off:
1) Can the Platform Eng lead (Nikhil) commit to a light roadmap note so we can re-evaluate backfill priority mid-Q3?
2) Any training/knowledge transfer plan for the Sr SE II being moved?

If both are reasonable, I approve; we should copy finance to flag there is no net new FTE spend this quarter.

—Marcus
Marcus Lin
VP, Platform Engineering

------------------------------------------------------------------
From: Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.com>
Cc: Tessa Morgan <tessa@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 15 Mar 2026 11:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Seat reallocation + backfill approval request — Platform Eng -> Customer Reliability

Thanks for the clear memo, Vivek. I agree with the proposed swap given the SLA exposure. Approvals from leadership: 
- Marcus: verbal approval noted in-thread.
- Me: approved conditionally on Tessa/Human Resources creating a formal backfill exception record that includes a re-evaluation checkpoint on 2026-08-01 and explicit owners for the paused project deliverables.

Tessa — can you initiate the exception workflow and confirm what documentation you need from us beyond the attached memo? If People Ops will require CFO signoff, please flag now so I can route.

Best,
Laura Bennett
Chief Product Officer
Redwood Inference

------------------------------------------------------------------
From: Tessa Morgan <tessa@redwood.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.com>
Cc: Elena Morales <elena@peopleops.co>
Date: Sun, 15 Mar 2026 13:27:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Seat reallocation + backfill approval request — Platform Eng -> Customer Reliability

Thanks — looping in Elena from People Ops Advisory to help with the exception template and to confirm process. Elena: quick asks from HR side:
- A one-paragraph justification signed by leadership (Laura + Marcus).
- Confirmation that the Platform Eng open req remains deactivated in Greenhouse with an internal note indicating the pause and planned re-eval date.
- A single finance note indicating no incremental headcount dollars for Q2 (we can link to the headcount-impact-model.xlsx).

Elena, can you draft the exception form and return it with comments by EOD tomorrow? If CFO review is required we'll escalate; from your note I expect this to be a People Ops sign-off with a fiscal ack.

Tessa Morgan
Head of People Operations, Talent Programs
Redwood Inference

From: Elena Morales <elena@peopleops.co>

Date: Sun, 15 Mar 2026 16:48:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Seat reallocation + backfill approval request — Platform Eng -> Customer Reliability

Thanks for the context — I can take point on the exception template. I will:
- Create the formal exception record and send a draft form by EOD Mon 2026-03-16.
- Add re-eval checkpoint for 2026-08-01 and a short owner section (Platform Eng lead for the paused project; Vivek for the transferred role onboarding deliverables).
- Confirm whether CFO acknowledgement is needed after I review the org-level headcount model.

Uploading a brief advisory checklist now to this thread (see seat_realloc_memo_v1.pdf).

Elena Morales
Senior Consultant, PeopleOps Advisory
elena@peopleops.co
